title: Fragmented Ecosystem, Emergent Roles: The Limits of the Penta Helix Model for Sustainable Digital Resilience
core_idea: Examine the practical application and effectiveness of the penta helix model (academia, business, government, community, media) in organizing multi-sector collaboration to sustain digital literacy resilience during urban digital transformation. The study uses an in-depth qualitative case study of Surakarta—semi-structured interviews with representatives from each penta helix sector plus thematic analysis of public policy and municipal documents—to investigate collaborative dynamics, evaluation practices, and how sectoral roles are organized in city digital literacy initiatives.
tldr: A qualitative case study of Surakarta that investigates how the penta helix model coordinates multi-sector actors around sustainable digital literacy resilience, focusing on collaborative dynamics and evaluation practices to inform evidence-informed governance considerations.
